paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.39% on average, with S&P 500 strongest (+0.58%) and Euro Stoxx 50 weakest (-1.35%). Brent crude changed +1.14% to 101.73. Gold changed -1.21% to 4,136.5. Bitcoin changed -2.26% to 83,623.4766. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.269%, a relative move of -0.79%. Among the firms tracked, Lazard (+3.06%) and Jefferies (-1.92%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: McKesson and CD&R strike $5.8bn deal to buy infusion services provider (FT Markets). Acquisition of Option Care Health is latest buyout of a healthcare services company trading below historic valuation multiples Deals and capital markets: NextEra’s $67bn Dominion takeover faces political backlash in Virginia (FT World). Rising power bills and concerns about monopoly power prompt officials to intervene in deal Central banks and macro: Trump eases red diesel limits in attempt to quell fuel inflation (FT Markets). US president announces the move during a trip to the agricultural state of Nebraska Central banks and macro: India raises interest rates for first time in 3 years (FT World). RBI points to higher inflation and energy costs as it shifts to ‘tightening’ outlook Geopolitics and trade: How the US financed World War I using Charlie Chaplin and Girl Scouts (FT Markets). When the US entered the war in 1917, it faced a massive financial challenge: how to pay for its contribution?
